message: 门式刚架跨度18m，同时总宽度又是12m，屋面荷载6kN/m，请分析

assertions.description: The agent must explicitly identify that the 18m span conflicts with the stated 12m total width, explain why one geometry must be selected, and ask the user which dimension is correct before building or analyzing. Merely asking for another missing parameter does not satisfy this criterion.
